evidence.title: 日下舊聞考 茹古涵今
evidence.excerpt_zh: 坦坦蕩蕩之南為茹古涵今五楹南向其後方殿為韶景軒四面各五楹韶景軒前東為茂育齋西為竹香齋又北為靜通齋（圓圓明園册）臣等謹按茹古涵今四十景之一也額為皇上御書韶景軒額恭懸軒内其外南簷額曰喜接南薰東簷額曰景麗東皇西簷額曰翠生西嶺北簷額曰清風北户與竹香齋額皆御書茂育齋静通齋額皆世宗御書
evidence.summary: South of 坦坦蕩蕩: the five-bay 茹古涵今 facing south; behind it the square 韶景軒 of five bays per side, with a plaque on each of its four eaves; 茂育齋, 竹香齋 and 靜通齋 around it.

evidence.title: 韶景轩: 乾隆四十一年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
evidence.date: 乾隆四十一年 (1776), date from the compilation
evidence.excerpt_zh: 京畿齐甸历巡辕，望雨每为心郁烦。雨足人归春过了，轩中韶景意恒存。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 韶景轩, 1776, on remembering his forebears. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 韶景轩: 乾隆四十二年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
evidence.date: 乾隆四十二年 (1777), date from the compilation
evidence.excerpt_zh: 书轩成已四十年，久矣题额曰韶景。向弗频莅兹偶临，丗载春光付轩领。喜新厌旧率人情，未能免俗吾应省。宣毫江砚绨几陈，遂以摛词窗移影。堂堂九十迅如斯，有为法䆒谁为永。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 韶景轩, 1777, on remembering his forebears. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 韶景轩
evidence.locator: v2 p.58, under 茹古涵今; source ref 1-311
evidence.excerpt_zh: 万汇沐帝恩，御园韶景富。山水含清晖，花柳开锦绣。东郊始农功，稼穑祈繁茂。圣人敬授时，青阳敷在宥。寅承惠民衷，寰区锡仁寿。
evidence.summary: Poem 韶景轩 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1798, filed by the editors under 茹古涵今.

evidence.title: 韶景轩: 嘉庆二十五年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
evidence.date: 嘉庆二十五年 (1820), date from the compilation
evidence.excerpt_zh: 佳日临轩骀荡春，楣悬御额焕三辰，庭心旭蔼筛林影，水面风来漾縠尘。长养收藏咸运化，飞潜动植普怀新。无涯韶景芳园布，敬授人时体昊仁。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 韶景轩, 1820. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 于韶景轩作歌
evidence.locator: v2 p.57, under 茹古涵今; source ref 12-665
evidence.excerpt_zh: 韶景轩故我题名，由来三十余年已。曾未拈毫一经咏，斯亦荒略殊甚耳。既而思之颇有说，日用不知系传旨。莫不饮食孰知味，君子之道诚鲜矣。
evidence.summary: Poem 于韶景轩作歌 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1775, filed by the editors under 茹古涵今.

evidence.title: Scene 11, 茹古涵今 Rugu Hanjin
evidence.excerpt_other: A square building, with eight columns on a side and a double roof, dominates this group of many courtyards, just west of the Emperor's private apartments.
evidence.summary: A square double-roofed hall, eight columns a side, in many courtyards west of 九洲清晏. Malone does not name it; the plan and Rixia place the square hall as 韶景轩.

evidence.title: 圆明园百景史事分景汇编: 韶景轩
evidence.locator: from p.130, under 茹古涵今
evidence.summary: 韶景轩: 4 dated items, 1776-1820, of which 4 poems (Qianlong, Jiaqing); recurring themes: remembering his forebears. First dated 1776, last dated 1820.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum and Historical Photographs of China; today's photographs on Commons.
